name: multiselect
title: Multiselect
blurb: Searchable dropdown selecting multiple items with checkboxes.
description: Renders a styled multi-select dropdown with search, checkboxes, and keyboard navigation via a command palette.
use_when: Users need to select multiple options from a filterable list.
avoid_when: Small lists where visual simplicity is critical, or mobile with limited screen space.
a11y: Checkbox-based selection with arrow key navigation. No explicit focus visible indicator described.
